label: ARP
notes: Ethernet/IPv4 ARP with the canonical 28-byte header (hardware length 6, protocol length 4). All nine fields of the fixed header are modelled, byte for byte. The sender/target addresses are payload-embedded: host primitives do not reach them (libpcap's `host` special-cases ARP but cannot tell sender from target), so they are first-class ipv4/mac fields — a mac compiles to a 4+2 two-load conjunction, the same shape libpcap emits for `ether host`. Other link/network combinations and RARP (RFC 903) are out of scope.

fields.label: Hardware Type
fields.description: IANA ARP hardware type: 1 = 10Mb Ethernet, 6 = IEEE 802, 15 = Frame Relay, 16 = ATM, 17 = HDLC, 18 = Fibre Channel.

fields.label: Protocol Type
fields.description: Ethertype of the mapped protocol: 0x0800 = IPv4, 0x86dd = IPv6 (NDP is used instead in practice).

fields.label: Hardware Address Length
fields.description: Length of each hardware address in octets; 6 for Ethernet MAC.

fields.label: Protocol Address Length
fields.description: Length of each protocol address in octets; 4 for IPv4.

fields.label: Target Hardware Address
fields.description: Zero in requests, the requester's MAC in replies.
